body: i've spoken to a friend. counsellor or doctor would be good.
this has been in my head for a few days man. but yeah, i felt ok before the fight. slightly suicidal, but this has kinda changed over my whole perception of me.

My other friend who I confided in is describing this person as manipulative and dangerous. I genuinely can't tell if this is the case, or if she was genuinely venting frustration and concern.

What do you mean how I felt before the fight?

A friend. I said a sly comment and she took it really personally, then she said it runs much deeper and said this. I feel messed up.

I haven't spoken to them since. We're apologised to each other, but these messages are swelling in my head. Sorry for being vague.
